original_example: Original host_cpu.h CCPU getCPL/setCPL use function pointers; OpenNT nt_cprgs.c assigns them to soft_ccpu_getCPL/soft_ccpu_setCPL, which read/write CPL.
current_example: Selected cpu4gen.h maps getCPL/setCPL to c_getCPL/c_setCPL; c_reg.c uses GET_CPL/SET_CPL, defined on CCPU_CPL in c_reg.h.
conclusion: Both provide read/write of a current-privilege state in their respective CPU implementations; this sample does not prove state identity, initialization equivalence, or equivalence of the full original pointer table.
status: open: enumerate original and selected accessor families and their actual callers before resolving CCPU empty shells
